games.name: Baldi's Basics - Classic
games.desc:
"Oh noes! Your friend left all of his notebooks at school and can't come back to get them because he's too busy! So, you decide to go back into the school to help him out.
But things aren't going to be that easy... You'll have to deal with professor Baldi and the rest of the school staff trying to stop you while you search through the halls and rooms for all the notebooks!

Can you collect them all and escape the schoolhouse?"

This game is an accurate Roblox recreation of classic Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning, based on version 1.4.3 of the original game. I tried my best to remake every bit of the entire game, gameplay, mechanics, and AI just like how they are in the actual game.

The game supports on almost every device, PC, mobile, console, etc. Headphones are recommended.
------------------------------------
Baldi's Basics By: Mystman12
Recreated By: Smiling_Mixer

games.name: Bloxrooms [Beta]
games.desc:
Endless rooms. Familiar places. Nothing is quite right.

Bloxrooms takes the games you think you remember and twists them into something that was never supposed to exist. Explore endless levels, uncover strange artifacts, and survive entities that don't follow the rules you thought you knew. The deeper you go, the more reality starts to fall apart. Every room feels familiar—but never exactly how you remember it.

🗺️ Explore Misremembered Levels
Discover corrupted areas inspired by games that feel strangely familiar.

👁️ Survive the Unknown
Watch for entities, study their behavior, and know when to run—or hide.

💎 Scavenge for Artifacts
Search each level for valuable artifacts and bring them back for cash.

🛠️ Upgrade Your Gear
Use your earnings to improve your equipment and push deeper into the rooms.

Tags: backrooms, liminal, horror, uncanny, entity, creature, kane pixels, exploration, adventure, survival, nostalgia, scary
